title: Author a gated VCF 9.1 architecture for a four-host mixed estate
prompt:
Platform architecture request. Produce the implementation-ready architecture for the synthetic single-site estate in `testdata/estate_inventory.json`. We need two views of the same site: a greenfield VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 design and an ordered migration of the existing mixed-version estate. The management domain is consolidated (management and tenant workloads share its one cluster) and must remain at the supported minimum of exactly four ESXi hosts; do not turn it into a second site, stretched cluster, or separate workload domain.

Research first, using your harness's real network search/fetch capabilities. Consult current, reachable Broadcom-published compatibility/interoperability material and upgrade-path guidance for every product/version relationship that affects the design, including the unusual NSX build in the fixture, plus Broadcom's published host-count guidance. The checked-in snapshot is grading data, not a substitute for this live research. Record what you actually consulted in `research.md`: access time in UTC, page title, exact reachable URL, and the decision each source informed; note any live-source disagreement with the pinned authority. The choice of sources and queries is yours.

Implement package `architecture` using only the Go standard library. Keep the public types already declared in `architecture.go` and implement `Load() (Architecture, error)` so it returns the embedded `architecture.json`, rejects malformed JSON and unknown fields, and does not read the network or depend on a working directory. Commit `architecture.json` as the machine-readable deliverable. Its `greenfield.sddcSpec` must be an SddcSpec instance valid against `#/components/schemas/SddcSpec` in `specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json`, pinned from tag `9.1.0.0` of `vmware/vcf-api-specs` (Apache-2.0). It must describe the one-site consolidated four-host design and the required management, vMotion, and vSAN networks. Do not replace, simplify, or generate a different installer schema.

The `existingEstate` object must validate against `testdata/migration_plan.schema.json`. Give every component from the inventory exactly one ordered step, with its exact current version, pinned target version, and compatibility gates. Select a path permitted by `testdata/compatibility_snapshot.json`, honor its component prerequisites, and explicitly route around every forbidden hop that applies to this estate. Do not solve the back-in-time blocker by downgrading, removing, or redeploying NSX. `architecture.json` and `Load()` must represent the same value.

The fixtures, pinned snapshot, installer specification, and `architecture_test.go` are protected. Verification is local and deterministic and never reads `research.md` or the network. Run `go test -race -timeout 30s ./...`.

research.product: VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 architecture and mixed-estate upgrade compatibility
research.interface: Broadcom compatibility/interoperability matrices, knowledge base, product documentation, and VMware VCF Installer OpenAPI 9.1.0.0
